create.name: Daneshe Yoga Centre
create.bio:
Daneshe Yoga is a long-standing yoga school in Tehran built around the work of its founder, Seyed Abdolhamid Movahedi. He came to yoga while living and studying in India in the late 1970s and early 1980s, began teaching in Kerman after his return to Iran, and moved the work to Tehran once yoga had been officially recognised in the country; the centre dates its activity from 1366 in the Iranian calendar. Alongside teaching and training instructors, it has published Daneshe Yoga, which it describes as Iran's only monthly yoga magazine, since 1381, and Movahedi has translated and written yoga books, among them a Persian Hatha Yoga Pradipika.

The centre teaches many styles side by side, including Sivananda, Iyengar, Ashtanga-Vinyasa, Hatha, Satyananda and yoga nidra, with pranayama and meditation, at its main centre on Motahari Street and a branch in Mahmoudieh. Its Sivananda classes follow the tradition's pattern of breathing, sun salutations, basic postures and relaxation, set within five principles that include positive thinking and meditation. Movahedi himself leads a short meditation course, and a longer course prepares future teachers. For many years the centre has also guided Iranian students to Sivananda teachers' training courses abroad, more than five hundred of them since 1375, and has led group study trips to Rishikesh and Nepal.

courses.title: دوره مدیتیشن با استاد سید عبدالحمید موحدی (Meditation course with Seyed Abdolhamid Movahedi)
courses.description: Four in-person sessions of meditation practice with the centre's founder, for women and men, at the main centre in Tehran: training attention, returning to the object of practice after distraction and observing experience with less judgement. Capacity 30; taught in Persian.

courses.title: یوگا شیواناندا (Sivananda yoga classes)
courses.description: Eight-session terms of Sivananda yoga for women at beginner, intermediate and advanced levels, twice a week on Sundays and Tuesdays at several times of day, following the classical pattern of breathing, sun salutations, basic postures and relaxation. Taught in Persian.

courses.title: دوره جامع آمادگی مربیگری یوگا سطوح فنی ۱ تا ۷ (Comprehensive yoga teacher preparation, technical levels 1 to 7)
courses.description: A long in-person course at the main centre preparing students to teach yoga, held on Thursday afternoons and Friday mornings and led by Leili Kheradmand. Taught in Persian.

flags: Lead from the Sivananda organisation's affiliated-centres list (sivananda.org/locations/affiliated-centres/, which gave www.danesheyoga.com). www.danesheyoga.com's robots.txt request redirected (301) to danesheyoga.com; that host's robots.txt (User-agent: * with no Disallow) was read before any other request. All facts come from danesheyoga.com, in Persian, translated by me.
The bio check ran against Persian source pages, so it cannot catch close translation; the bio was written in my own words from the translated facts.

Dates on the site are in the Iranian (Solar Hijri) calendar: founding 1366 (= 1987/88, so founded_year 1987), the magazine from 1381 (2002/03), study in India 1358-1363 (1979-1985), and TTC guidance since 1375 (1996/97). The meditation course starts '22 Aban', which is 13 November 2026 (a Friday, matching its Friday schedule).
Prices are copied literally as published (no currency shown next to the figures; the site's cart is labelled in toman). The meditation and Sivananda prices are both '3,000,000'.
The meditation course page is inconsistent: it shows level 'beginner' in one place and 'advanced' in another, and Monday 17:45-18:45 in the text but Friday 9:00-13:00 in the box with the start date.
Sivananda classes on the site are women-only (بانوان) and taught by Soheila Movahedi; course detail 13 is one of several identical class pages.
The Sivananda TTC page describes the centre arranging for Iranians to attend TTCs at Sivananda centres abroad (a guidance and travel service), not a TTC held in Tehran; it is left out as an offering.
The centre is large and commercial: it also sells yoga equipment under its Chakrakala brand and sells the magazine; neither is listed.
Iran: sanctions may affect payment or links; the owner may decide whether to list.

Photos: a meditation class led by an older man in white at the centre (course image), a man in a side-angle pose on a lawn, and a portrait (both from the About page; likely the founder, not captioned in the text read).
Contact also lists m.danesheyoga@gmail.com and chakrakala@danesheyoga.com (shop); info@danesheyoga.com is used as the brand inbox.
Possible future listings: Seyed Abdolhamid Movahedi (founder, author/translator).
No Spiritpedia teachers are named on the site, so the teachers file has no links.
Regional: Tehran; Spiritpedia likely has no listings in Iran.
left_out: Comprehensive Ayurveda course (in person and online, Dr Sohrab Dehghan): health rule.
Therapeutic/corrective yoga (حرکات اصلاحی) and prenatal yoga categories: health rule.
The meditation page's summary of research on stress, anxiety and sleep: health rule.
Sivananda TTC/ATTC and Yoga Alliance guidance pages: arranging attendance at other organisations' courses, prices not fixed.
Past trips to Rishikesh (Mehr 1396) and Nepal: passed.
